Document gap 1 (partial revert inside a file the line also changed; revert of work below the cut point) as an accepted limit in docs/07-crosscutting.md:680-684 and the integrate.py module docstring — docs only, no test, could ship on its own
proposed_seams: Possible cut between the code fix and the gap-1 documentation: the docs note does not depend on the new check and could be its own docs-only PR. I would not cut it. It is a few lines next to the same #623 text the fix already touches, it has no test of its own, and splitting it adds a second edit to the docs/07-crosscutting.md stack-mode section that 672, 694 and 695 also edit — more conflict ordering for very little gain.

No seam inside the code change. (1)/(2)/(2b)/(3) are one rule (refuse a bundle merge that removes line work, unless the branch's own commits did it) seen from different histories; the own-commit exemption and the refusal wording cannot ship apart from the check they belong to.

Why watch and not ok: the surface is uncertain, not wide. Three rebuild rounds so far all turned on the same hard part — how to tell a branch's own commits from base commits it carries (first-parent rule, walk stop points, ambiguous shared commits). That is risk inside one outcome, not a second outcome.
